
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /good  (/+)                                │
  │  Positive Feedback                          │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Mark the last response as good (positive feedback).

  Usage:
    /good
    /+

  Details:
    Records positive feedback on the last response. RadSim uses this
    to learn your preferences and improve future responses.

  Examples:
    $ /good
    $ /+

  Related: /improve  /stats
